green label with white text and black bean image
text 'Clande Tkin 8Pney' on the label
text 'BESTERBENC' below the main text
text 'on Revk tllc' below 'BESTERBENC'
yellow band with black beans at the bottom of the label

detail.issues: Model A has incorrect text (e.g., 'BESTERLENG' instead of 'BESTERBENC'), missing details like the leaf on the beans, and wrong bean arrangement. Model B has incorrect text (e.g., 'ESTERLENG' instead of 'BESTERBENC'), missing the leaf on the beans, and incorrect bean arrangement with some missing beans.
Model A has less defined stitching and smoother surface compared to the reference. Model B has incorrect panel shapes and stitching patterns, with some panels misaligned or distorted.

features.feature: round gold case with two concentric rings
white clock face with black Roman numerals
three clock hands (hour, minute, second)
red second hand
Jiffy text on the clock face
gold crown and loop on top

detail.issues: Model A has minor clock face angle and dial details differences; Model B has more noticeable dial text and shape variations, plus surface texture inconsistencies.

features.feature: large spherical balloon with metal framework
long cylindrical gondola below balloon
metal framework connecting balloon and gondola
small cabin structure on gondola
small cargo boxes at bottom
beige canvas material for balloon and gondola
metal framework with visible cross-bracing

detail.issues: Model A has incorrect color tones (paler than reference) and simplified structural details. Model B has significant geometric distortions in the balloon shape and missing structural elements like the reference's framework and gondola details.

features.feature: circular shape with 20 numbered segments
black outer ring with white numbers 0-20
red outer bullseye ring
green middle ring
green and red inner bullseye
alternating black and colored segments
central green dot with red center

detail.issues: Model A has incorrect number labels (e.g., '8', '14') and color mismatches in segments; Model B has accurate numbers but slightly off segment colors and a less detailed surface texture compared to the reference.
Model A has incorrect nib shape and missing metal ring near the feather; Model B has incorrect nib shape and feather color/texture differences.

Model A has incorrect bead arrangement and missing beads on the curved surface; Model B has less accurate bead colors and positions, with some beads missing or misplaced, and the wood texture is less detailed.
